basic_details.job_title: HBTU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 25 Professor, Associate Professor and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Professor - Oil Technology, Assistant Professor - Electronics Engineering, Assistant Professor - Electrical Engineering and 18 more
basic_details.short_information: Harcourt Butler Technical University, Kanpur (HBTU), Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for 25 posts in 21 roles under Advt No. 1460/HBTU/Estt/01/2026. The posts include Professor - Oil Technology, Assistant Professor - Electronics Engineering, Assistant Professor - Electrical Engineering, Associate Professor - MCA and 17 more. The online application is open from 26 October 2026 to 8 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online. Last date to pay the fee: 8 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: As per University / U.P. State Govt. norms

qualification.education_qualification: As per prevailing guidelines of AICTE/UGC / HBTU Recruitment Rules

how_to_apply: Visit HBTU Kanpur website www.hbtu.ac.in and click on the Faculty Recruitment link.
Complete the registration for teaching or non-teaching posts.
Fill the online application form and upload scanned passport-size photo and signature (20-100 kb).
Upload relevant proofs for qualifications, publications, experience, projects, etc.
Preview the form and submit online application fee.
Submit the final application and take a printout for records.
important_instructions: The number of posts advertised is indicative and the University reserves the right to increase or decrease posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HBTU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit HBTU Kanpur website www.hbtu.ac.in and click on the Faculty Recruitment link. Complete the registration for teaching or non-teaching posts. Fill the online application form and upload scanned passport-size photo and signature (20-100 kb). Upload relevant proofs for qualifications, publications, experience, projects, etc. Preview the form and submit online application fee. Submit the final application and take a printout for records. Apply on or before 8 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The number of posts advertised is indicative and the University reserves the right to increase or decrease posts.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HBTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 8 December 2026. Applications opened on 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HBTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 25 vacancies: 1 Professor - Oil Technology, 1 Assistant Professor - Electronics Engineering, 1 Assistant Professor - Electrical Engineering, 1 Associate Professor - MCA, 1 Associate Professor - Mechanical Engineering, 1 Professor - Chemical Engineering and 15 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for HBTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR, EWS, OBC: Rs. 2000. SC, ST: Rs. 1500.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per prevailing guidelines of AICTE/UGC / HBTU Recruitment Rules. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates already in employment are required to apply Through Proper Channel. Reservation will be as per UP Government Norms (Vertical & Horizontal).

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with Ph.D. from foreign universities without Equivalence Certificate from AIU, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening and shortlisting of applications. Interview. Assessment Methodology based on Screening and Selection Criteria.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kanpur.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Photograph and signature; Caste certificate on prescribed format of Government of U.P; Proofs of qualifications, publications, experience, projects, research guidance.
